title: Abbas jo zinda hai
body:
Abbas jo zinda hai
Abbas...
Baawafaa Ya Abbas....
Abbas, abbas, abbas, abbas..(2)
Mehfooz qaafela Hai Abbas Jo zindaa Hai
Abhi door karbala Hai..(3), Abbas Jo zindaa Hai
1) Is noori ka Karwaa mey noori amaariyaa hai
Noori amaariyo mey (noori sawaariyaa Hai)..(2)
Sarr par Alam khulaa Hai, Abbas Jo zindaa Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Naa mehramo ka majmaa hat-hat key Hai guzarta
Pehrey mey baawafaa ke (Taiy horaha Hai rastaa)..(2)
Kya shaan o dabdabaa Hai, Abbas Jo zindaa Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Abbas jaisa Bhai saalaar kaarwaa Hai
Boley Husain mujhko (phir koi ghum kahaa Hai)..(2)
Har ghum ki ye dawaa Hai, Abbas Jo zindaa Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Zainab hayaa ki malka kulsoom aur ruqayya
Laila, rabaab, farwaa, (kubraa, Sakina, fizza)..(2)
Har Bibi baaridaa Hai, Abbas Jo zindaa Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Asghar se khelti Hai khush Hai bohat sakina
Jab chaahti Hai Sona (Hai baba jaa ka seena)..(2)
Ghum se na aashna Hai, Abbas Jo zindaa hai
